# Masterclass in Value Investing

Discover how one of India's biggest contra funds is managed, with insights from Taher Badshah of Invesco India. This masterclass offers a deep dive into the principles of value investing and the strategies employed by top fund managers to navigate market cycles.

## How Top Funds Performed in 2025

Most investors spend time picking the best fund. Very few ask a simpler question: Once you invest, how often does that fund actually deliver? We decided to check with real data on our own recommendations. The results might surprise you.
